signature.one_line: Still group shot under a colon-ended serif title, then a textless ~10-frame-per-clip highlight burst.
unique_devices: Hold-then-burst: a near-static opener for ~44 % of runtime, then 16 clips of 6-13 frames each (~110 cuts/min, up to ~190 in the peak window)
Two-line title that ends in a colon: small white condensed serif lead-in over a large accent brush italic key phrase, first word regular and key word bold at the same size
Title lives only on the opener and hard-cuts out with it; the burst carries no text at all
Burst ordered by intensity, ending on the biggest visual (pyro / jets / fireworks) so the loop restarts on a high
signature.why_it_works: The colon promises a list; the long still hold builds tension; the burst pays it off faster than it can be read, inviting a rewatch.

hook.type: open loop (title ending in a colon)
hook.first_frame: Near-static warm, softly faded medium shot of three young crew members with staff passes leaning on a railing, venue behind; 2-line title above their heads

structure.what: Still group shot with the colon-ended title; short trend voice line then music
10-clip burst of perks: venue, stage acts, lasers, DJ, athletes
6 more clips escalating to fireworks, crowd, flame and CO2 jets; ends on the biggest visual

background_text.how: Centred above the subjects' heads: line 1 white condensed serif centre 23.8 % H (x 35-65 %), line 2 accent brush italic centre 28.7 % H (x 18-82 %), 0.9 % H gap; on from frame 0, static, hard-cut out with the shot

broll_inserts.how: 16 handheld clips, 6-13 frames each (median ~10), full frame, ungraded and saturated; order by intensity, biggest visual last

camera.how: Near-static medium group shot, subjects in the lower 2/3, clean sky/venue above for the title
Wides of stages and crowds, no punch-ins

transitions.how: 44 % of changes are 2-3-frame blends, the rest hard cuts, all on music beats

other_text_spec.copy: short lead-in, ~12 characters, sentence case (placeholder 'Lead words')
other_text_spec.font_class: condensed old-style serif, regular/medium, bracketed serifs, tall ascenders
other_text_spec.fit_note: original is a condensed serif (width/height ratio 0.67 of Playfair); Playfair 63 px balances height and width; for the look use a condensed serif and size it to the measured ink

other_text_spec.copy: two-word key phrase ending with ' :' (placeholder 'KEY WORD :'); first word regular weight, second word bold, same size
other_text_spec.font_class: informal brush italic (single-storey a and g, flared strokes)

other_text_spec.entry: on screen from frame 0, no animation
other_text_spec.idle: static; the opener shot itself is near-static
other_text_spec.exit: hard cut out with the opener shot (~116 frames); the burst after it has no text

style.look_intent: warm, softly faded, high-contrast opener; burst clips left saturated and natural (blue lasers, magenta, orange pyro, daylight venue)

sound.music: trend audio: a short voice line over the first ~17 % (speech_coverage 0.17), then a music drop; beat periodicity 0.37, ~182 bpm estimate
sfx: none added; burst cuts follow the music (detector cut_hit_share 0.0 on 9 hard cuts, so they sit between onsets)
optional: drop / impact on the first burst cut

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Big-Text Hook
catalog_styles.role: colon-ended 2-line title on the still opener

catalog_styles.name: Oversized Editorial Headlines
catalog_styles.role: serif lead-in + brush italic key phrase pairing

catalog_styles.name: Circular Storytelling (Looping Narrative)
catalog_styles.role: ends on the biggest visual so the loop restarts high

use_when: the user has one calm group/team shot plus many short highlight clips
the concept is a 'job perks / backstage access' trend or a list-like tease
the piece should stay in the micro duration class and loop well
music or trend audio carries it with no voiceover
avoid_when: the message needs explanation or captions
fewer than ~12 usable highlight clips are available
the audience needs to read anything during the burst
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B42 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B42.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO captions: one 2-line title on a still opener, then a textless highlight burst. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the sky/background behind the title; {{TEXT}} must sit on a non-white area)
- {{TEXT}}: lead-in line, default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: key phrase, default #FF0021
- {{ACCENT_2}}: unused, default none
- {{SURFACE}}: unused (no cards), default none
- {{CARD_BG}}: unused, default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: key phrase brush italic, default Playfair Display 700 italic (Merienda 700 closer in feel)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: lead-in condensed serif, default Playfair Display 500 (Instrument Serif closer)
- {{HANDLE}}: not shown in the source
- {{LOGO}}: not shown in the source

OTHER TEXT (opener only)
1. First shot near-static, ~44 % of runtime, title in clean sky/background above the subjects' heads. Two centred lines, no stroke/shadow/box:
   a. Lead-in ("Lead words", ~12 characters): {{FONT_BODY}} 63 px, {{TEXT}}, centre y 23.8 % H (x 35-65 %, ink ~4.14 % H). With a condensed serif size it to that ink.
   b. Key phrase ending in " :" ("KEY WORD :"): {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 78 px, {{ACCENT}}, centre y 28.7 % H (x 18-82 %), 0.9 % H under line 1; first word regular weight, key word bold, same size (ink ~4.06 % H / 63.3 % W at ~17 characters).
2. Both lines on from frame 0, static, hard-cut out with the opener shot. No text in the burst.

EDIT
3. Burst: 16 clips of 6-13 frames (median ~10, ~110 cuts/min, peak ~190) on the music beats, 44 % as 2-3-frame blends and the rest hard cuts; order by intensity and end on the biggest visual so the loop restarts high. No punch-ins.

SOUND: short trend voice line or sting over the opener, then the music drop on the first burst cut. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, softly faded opener; burst clips kept saturated and natural.

VERIFY before rendering: render the title with the brand's lines (or "Lead words" / "KEY WORD :") and measure:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.15,0.26,0.85,0.31 --ink "#FF0021:90"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.3,0.205,0.7,0.26 --ink "#FFFFFF:35"
Swap the --ink colours to {{ACCENT}} / {{TEXT}}. Compute the expected ink of the actual lines with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py (63 px {{FONT_BODY}}, 78 px {{FONT_DISPLAY}}); a ~17-character key phrase should read ~4.06 % H / 63.3 % W. Line centres within +-1 % of frame height of 23.8 / 28.7 %.
